judgement.reason: Penpot's production deployment needs several separate application services (frontend, backend, exporter, MCP) that run together from different images, and Deployz runs only one web service.

evidence.quote: ## Single database configuration block, shared by backend and admin-console.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker/images/docker-compose.yaml defines 5 application services (penpot-frontend, penpot-backend, penpot-admin-console, penpot-mcp, penpot-exporter). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The shown lines do not prove that the five application services in the compose file are optional or are datastores that Deployz provides, so the multi-service finding remains open for the vendor to confirm.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume penpot_assets:/opt/data/assets (docker/images/docker-compose.yaml penpot-frontend), volume penpot_assets:/opt/data/assets (docker/images/docker-compose.yaml penpot-backend)
reviews.reason: No shown setting moves the penpot_assets data at /opt/data/assets to S3 or another managed store, so the durable local storage finding remains open for the vendor to confirm.
